lean.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hu : ∃ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ,
      InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd v (Metric.closedBall a r) ∧
      Set.EqOn v u (Metric.closedBall a r)),
    let τ : MeasureTheory.Measure (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) :=
      (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).toSphere
    (∫ ζ : Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1,
      u (a + r • (ζ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) ∂((τ Set.univ)⁻¹ • τ)) = u a
approved_definition_context: EuclideanSpace real (Fin n) is real n-dimensional Euclidean space with its standard l2 norm. The sphere subtype consists of vectors of norm one.

HarmonicOnNhd f K means: at every x in K, f is C2 on a neighborhood of x and its actual Euclidean Laplacian vanishes on a neighborhood of x. The Laplacian is the trace of the actual second real Frechet derivative.
EqOn v u K means v(x)=u(x) for every x in K. It imposes no equality or regularity outside K.
The volume is actual Euclidean Lebesgue volume. For a measurable subset A of the unit-sphere subtype, volume.toSphere(A) is n times volume of its cone {s*zeta:0<s<1,zeta in A}.

Measure scalar multiplication uses an extended nonnegative coefficient. The coefficient (tau univ)^(-1) is the inverse of the actual total mass. The integral is the real Bochner integral; an integral equality alone does not assert L1.
